sources: Budget Law 1404 (Part One) (قانون بودجه سال ۱۴۰۴ کل کشور (بخش اول)), approved by the Majlis 8 Bahman 1403, Expediency Council 10 Bahman 1403, Speaker's letter No. 235/75483 of 13 Bahman 1403, promulgated 14 Bahman 1403: Note 1(ز)(1)-(3) (art. 84 exemption 2,880,000,000 rials; 10 % to 3,600,000,000, 15 % to 4,560,000,000, 20 % to 6,000,000,000, 25 % to 8,000,000,000, 30 % above; faculty, full-time physicians and judges under art. 85; 10 % on overtime and similar extras; withholding through the tax organisation's system) and Note 1(ث) (art. 101 business and art. 57 rent exemptions 2,000,000,000 rials). Read on the scan of the promulgated text with the www.dotic.ir watermark and the Speaker's letterhead, pp. 1, 10-11, from the copy at https://www.ekhtebar.ir/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/قانون-بودجه-۱۴۰۴.pdf (live file = Internet Archive capture 20250215212522; 101 pp.; sha256 561363b20facbb499dcf718ae2af8c0994111db757e26cd5bd3f9b827125552f; ir/law/rescue3/budget1404_part1_dotic_scan.pdf); transcription cross-checked: ekhtebar.ir page 'قانون بودجه سال ۱۴۰۴ کل کشور (بخش اول)' (Internet Archive capture 20251115083103). Direct Taxes Act, English translation on the Iran Data Portal (Syracuse University), https://irandataportal.syr.edu/section-3-income-tax (pre-1394 text: art. 85 still prints the 1388 figure): arts. 82-86, 91 (5: pensions exempt), 92; second copy: UN ESCAP Asia Pacific Energy Portal https://policy.asiapacificenergy.org/sites/default/files/directtaxationact.pdf (older text).
headline: Iran's 1404 salary tax from the promulgated Budget Law (Note 1(ز)): 2.88 bn rials a year exempt, then 10 % rising to 30 % above 8 bn, on each person's salary from all sources together
